name_input: ANEETA PLAST PACK LLP (Parent Company Girnar Group)
product_summary: Aneeta Plastpack LLP is listed on the Girnar Group website (girnargroup.com/contact-us/) as one of the group's three manufacturing units: 'Aneeta Plastpack LLP, Plot no. A/29, GIDC, Sector 25, Gandhinagar-382025'. The group's product page (girnargroup.com/products/) lists four product lines: (1) Aluminum Collapsible Tubes, (2) Multi Layered Laminated Tubes (plastic laminated tubes, 8-colour printing + 2 foil colours, Swiss tube-making machines, stated capacity 100 mln tubes/yr), (3) Aluminum Rigid Containers, (4) Caps and Closures. The group homepage additionally names 'plastic tubes, bottles, corrugated carton boxes, flexible films, caps and closures' and states end-markets: pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, oral care, chemicals, food, adhesives. The site does NOT break the product range down per legal entity, so it is not publicly determinable which of these lines physically run at the A/29 Sector-25 plant of Aneeta Plastpack LLP specifically. No product-level catalogue, e-catalogue PDF or SKU list for the LLP itself was retrievable (the 'E-Catalogue' link is not publicly resolvable; product sub-pages returned 404).
role_hint: manufacturer (per group self-description: 'We are the manufacturers and suppliers of aluminum tubes and containers, plastic tubes, bottles, corrugated carton boxes, flexible films, caps and closures'); no trader/intermediary signs found. Entity-level manufacturing status for the LLP itself is заявлено, не подтверждено.
comment: HS 392330 ('carboys, bottles, flasks, jars and similar articles, of plastics') is PARTIALLY correct: it plausibly covers the plastic laminated tube / plastic bottle part of the range, but it is too narrow for the declared business and misses the group's core lines. Corrected/expanded mapping: plastic collapsible/laminated tubes and plastic bottles/jars -> 392330 (matches declaration); plastic caps and closures -> 392350; other plastic packaging articles (flexible films in roll form, plastic containers n.e.s.) -> 392390, with plastic flexible film in rolls more precisely 3920/3921 (392010/392190) rather than 3923; ALUMINUM collapsible tubes -> 761210 (aluminium collapsible tubular containers) - this is the group's flagship line (200 mln tubes/yr capacity) and is a completely different chapter (76) from the declared 3923, i.e. a product line entirely missing from the declaration; aluminium rigid containers -> 761290; corrugated carton boxes -> 481910. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: the claimed industry 'Строительство и DIY' (Construction & DIY) is wrong. Girnar Group is a packaging converter serving pharma, cosmetics, oral care, chemicals, food and adhesives - i.e. packaging/plastics-aluminium converting, not construction materials. No building/DIY product appears anywhere on the site. TRADER SIGNS: none - the group presents itself as an integrated manufacturer with in-house German and Swiss tube lines; however the export mailbox is exports@aneetaindia.com, i.e. exports are handled at group level, not by the LLP, so the LLP may be one plant within a multi-entity export structure (possible intra-group supply chain). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the factual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data above is from the group's own website and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no customs line, B/L or shipment record was checked or found in this HS-only review, and no entity-level catalogue corroborates which lines belong to this LLP. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN and registry data were deliberately not researched (out of scope for this role) - null.
